_comments: CHARGE-TO-PAYMENT RECONCILIATION (#477). Its own dot-json so it conflicts with no other change to
Action; this operation carries the whole check so the Action stays an adapter.

fields.Name: Reconcile Payment Provider Charges
fields.Description: Match a payment gateway's charges and refunds to Orders' payment intents and captured payments for a window of business days (default: the seven days ending today), and report three kinds of mismatch: a charge with no captured payment, a captured payment whose charge the gateway does not have, and a refunded charge whose payment carries fewer refunds. Corrects nothing. With Preview (the default) it only reports; otherwise each mismatch is raised as a PROVIDER_CHARGE_MISMATCH finance exception, once per mismatch and amount. Only live providers are read; a provider in test mode runs the stub driver and is skipped.
